report.title: Payment-provider API key expired causing payment failures (since 2026-11-27T17:48Z)
report.summary: Starting ~2026-11-27T17:48Z, payment-service requests began failing because the Fabrikam Payments API key expired. This prevented charges from succeeding and degraded the checkout flow.
report.customerImpact: Approximately 96% of payment attempts are failing (payment-service error_rate 0.96) since 2026-11-27T17:48Z; customers cannot complete purchases and orders are not being created for paid transactions.

rootCause.description: The Fabrikam Payments API key expired at 2026-11-27T17:48Z. payment-service calls to Fabrikam now return 401 Unauthorized invalid_api_key, causing provider requests to fail and the service to surface errors to callers.

evidence.detail: payment-service error_rate jumped from baseline 0.0039 to 0.9624; change detected startedAt 2026-11-27T17:48Z (latest 0.9624). provider_error_rate also rose from 0.0019 to 0.9711 with change start 2026-11-27T17:48Z.

52 ERROR logs in payment-service between 2026-11-27T17:48Z and 2026-11-27T18:00Z: 'Fabrikam Payments returned <n> Unauthorized: invalid_api_key (key expired) orderId=<orderId>' — sample: 'Fabrikam Payments returned 401 Unauthorized: invalid_api_key (key expired) orderId=ord_5523A'.
payment-service config shows secret FabrikamApiKey sourced from appsettings.Production.json and expiresAt '2026-11-27T17:48Z'; secret is stored as plain config and rotation is manual.
getServiceHealth shows checkout-api and checkout-web degraded; payment-service p95 latency dropped (requests failing fast) while error_rate spiked to ~0.96 starting 2026-11-27T17:48Z.

recommendedActions.rationale: Replace the expired API key with a valid Fabrikam Payments API key in production, then restart or reload payment-service so requests succeed. This directly addresses the 401 invalid_api_key errors.

Trigger failover to Northwind Pay to restore payment success immediately while Fabrikam key is rotated. payment-service config shows failoverEnabled=true; failing over mitigates customer impact faster than waiting for rotation.

recommendedActions.target: Move FabrikamApiKey to managed Key Vault and enable automated rotation
recommendedActions.rationale: Store secrets in Key Vault (migrate from appsettings.Production.json) and enable automated rotation/alerts to prevent future expirations and reduce blast radius of manual secrets.

recommendedActions.target: Enable alerting and runbook for expiring secrets
recommendedActions.rationale: Add monitoring and pre-expiry alerts for secret.expiresAt to notify on-call earlier (e.g., 7d/1d/1h before expiry).
After rotation or failover, monitor payment-service error_rate, provider_error_rate, and checkout success rate for at least 30 minutes to ensure recovery and check for duplicate charges.

followUps: Verify whether any charges were partially accepted or queued by Fabrikam and reconcile with order-service to avoid double-charges when switching providers.

If failover is used, ensure idempotency handling during provider swap to avoid duplicate charges; payment-service currently has idempotency.required=false so consider enabling idempotency keys for provider requests.
